sections.title: Service and network model
sections.nextStep: Confirm the discovered SKU and injection mode match the intended topology.

sections.title: Subnet, placement and capacity
sections.coverage: Partial: actual free IPs, dedicated occupancy and upgrade headroom require corroboration
sections.nextStep: Compare subnet placement, delegation and capacity with the SKU-specific requirements; verify allocation and upgrade headroom separately.

sections.title: NSG rules
sections.coverage: Ordered rule evaluation; unresolved service-tag or ASG overlap remains unknown
sections.nextStep: Inspect the identified rule priority and required flow. Do not add a rule until earlier matches and intended policy are understood.

sections.title: Service endpoints
sections.coverage: Proactive classic endpoint recommendations; required safeguard gaps under forced tunneling; firewall alternatives and optional Event Hubs use require corroboration
sections.nextStep: Recommend endpoints from the start to protect dependencies against later VNet changes. With forced tunneling, missing applicable endpoints are required safeguard gaps unless a maintained firewall alternative is verified; not proof of an outage.

sections.title: Routes and forced tunneling
sections.coverage: Default UDR next-hop classification and classic ApiManagement -> Internet service-tag safeguard; effective BGP, regional-tag coverage and firewall paths remain unverified
sections.nextStep: Verify effective routes and symmetric control-plane return paths. Recommend an ApiManagement service-tag Internet UDR proactively; it is required with forced tunneling. Keep this separate from NSG TCP 3443 permission.

sections.title: DNS and name resolution
sections.coverage: Configured resolver ports only; no DNS answers or resolver logs collected
sections.nextStep: If an actual DNS symptom is reported, obtain approved resolver/client-path evidence. This VNet configuration check does not establish DNS answers.

sections.title: APIM network connection status
sections.coverage: All collected Azure Network status observations shown unfiltered: reported connectivity, requirement, original UTC timestamps and freshness at capture
sections.nextStep: Use the connection table in this report first. Azure Portal Network status is supplementary for current error details or newer observations, not a prerequisite for viewing the captured statuses.

sections.title: TLS and certificates
sections.coverage: Not assessed: no handshake, certificate-chain or TLS log evidence collected
sections.nextStep: Outside this configuration check. If a real TLS symptom exists, distinguish client-to-gateway from gateway-to-backend evidence; a pre-HTTP handshake failure may have no gateway request log.

sections.title: Client and backend traffic
sections.coverage: Not assessed: no application traffic generated or gateway/backend request logs collected
sections.nextStep: Outside this configuration check. A reported request failure needs existing gateway/backend evidence for its exact UTC interval and request ID; do not send traffic automatically.

sections.title: Optional feature dependencies
sections.coverage: Not assessed: feature usage and destination telemetry were not collected
sections.nextStep: Outside this configuration check. Inspect a named optional platform failure only when applicable; do not infer feature use or add unused feature rules.

sections.title: Infrastructure and FQDN egress
sections.coverage: Not assessed: no firewall/NVA, DNS-flow or platform-FQDN traffic logs collected
sections.nextStep: Outside this configuration check. A named failed egress path needs existing platform/firewall evidence before proposing changes; do not open broad internet access.

sections.title: Evidence quality and collection
sections.coverage: Collection gaps, freshness and location coverage are explicit; telemetry coverage is not assessed
sections.nextStep: Resolve actual read gaps and stale observations. Missing log evidence cannot establish health or reconstruct events that were never recorded.
